name: Sweepers!
source:
Takuya Hayami  is an ordinary university first grader. However, his constitution allows him to easily invite spirits to his body. His childhood friend Mizuki Fuko has been in coma for a long time because she got involved into youkai extermination incident.

Now he goes to a spa resort with his lover Miyuki Kusuhara, but he hears Fuko words and there's going to be a new ghost riot.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塔库亚·哈亚米是一名普通的大学一年级学生，却有着容易让灵魂附身的体质。他的青梅竹马水木风子，因为卷入一场妖怪讨伐事件，已经昏迷了很长时间。

如今，他与恋人楠原美幸一起前往温泉度假，却听见了风子的声音。新的鬼魂骚乱即将发生。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
